comments.text: My tyre has been punctured at the rim side. Will it be covered in warranty?
comments.author: @Madhu-oq8cx

comments.text:
No, it is usually not covered under warranty.
Tyre warranties typically cover manufacturing defects like bulges, separation, or tread issues—not damage caused by external factors like punctures, especially on the sidewall or rim area. Rim-side punctures are considered accidental damage or improper use, which voids the warranty.
